name: phd-group-pin-is-a-preference
description: Red-team F2 (2026-09-12): Algorithms and Architecture covered, and Research Methods (listed under every group) pinned by the student to Algorithms — a pick that would strand the course. A pin is a preference, not a rule: the matcher takes the assignment that covers three groups, reports it as met, names the better pick, and `groupAssignments` carries what the page pre-fills.

detailIncludes: chosen to cover the most groups
